description: Chenab Limited is a composite textile company at Nishatabad, Faisalabad, founded within the Chenab Group that Mian Muhammad Latif established in 1974. It runs spinning, weaving, processing, stitching, embroidery and quilting and wadding operations, and offers home furnishing and apparel among its product lines. Its spinning division spins carded and combed yarns in counts from 10 to 80.
headOffice: Chenab Limited, Nishatabad, Faisalabad, Punjab 38000, Pakistan
